title: What is a Ramsar Site?
description: Identify the meaning of a Ramsar Site.
hint: It relates to internationally important wetlands.
summary: A Ramsar Site is a wetland designated as internationally important under the Convention on Wetlands.

title: The Ramsar Convention is primarily concerned with the conservation of what?
description: Identify the main subject of the Ramsar Convention.
hint: Think of lakes, marshes and other water ecosystems.
summary: The Ramsar Convention focuses on wetlands and their conservation and wise use.

title: Where was the Ramsar Convention adopted?
description: Identify the place associated with the adoption of the Convention on Wetlands.
hint: It is a city in Iran.
summary: The Ramsar Convention was adopted in Ramsar, Iran, in 1971.

title: In which year was the Ramsar Convention adopted?
description: Identify the year in which the Convention on Wetlands was adopted.
hint: It was adopted in the early 1970s.
summary: The Ramsar Convention was adopted in 1971.

title: When did the Ramsar Convention enter into force?
description: Identify the year when the Ramsar Convention became legally effective.
hint: It was a few years after adoption.
summary: The Ramsar Convention entered into force in 1975.

title: When did India become a party to the Ramsar Convention?
description: Identify the year India joined the Convention on Wetlands.
hint: It was in the early 1980s.
summary: India became a contracting party to the Ramsar Convention on 1 February 1982.

title: Which were India's first two Ramsar Sites?
description: Identify the first wetlands from India added to the Ramsar List.
hint: One is a lake in Rajasthan and the other is a national park in Rajasthan.
summary: Keoladeo National Park and Chilika Lake were among India's first Ramsar Sites, designated in 1981.

options.title: Chilika Lake and Keoladeo National Park

description: Identify the major lagoon on India's eastern coast.

summary: Chilika Lake is a major brackish-water lagoon on India's eastern coast.

title: Which Ramsar Site is famous for the endangered Sangai deer?

title: What are phumdis associated with?
description: Identify the floating vegetation masses characteristic of a famous northeastern lake.

summary: Phumdis are floating masses of vegetation, soil and organic matter found prominently in Loktak Lake.
